words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening a fresh but linked observation after the prior reminder statement
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a fresh observation while keeping the previous statement about reminder in view. The particle turns the sign-filled cosmos into immediate evidence for why reminder is needed: what is already present is still being passed over.

topics.headline: resumptive shift into evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not a loose addition; it resumes the prior reminder claim by opening a new evidentiary scene.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the particle at the head of a new main predication, while the CRITICAL rows converge on linked resumption rather than simple coordination.

words.gloss_range: bound degree element inside the fixed abundance quantifier, not an ordinary free comparison

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second element of the fused how-many quantifier

words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) is heard as part of the fused quantifier, not as a free simile marker. Its comparison-like residue becomes degree pressure: magnitude arrives before the counted sign is named.

topics.headline: bound degree inside quantifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as abundance, not as an ordinary likeness between signs and another object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the first two elements as a construction unit, so the CRITICAL comparison rows are preserved as degree residue rather than a free comparative reading.

words.gloss_range: exclamatory how-many quantifier functioning as subject and turning abundance into reproach
words.prose: {{ar:أَيِّنْ}} ({{tr:ayyin}}) carries the quantifier as the grammatical subject of the larger clause. It does not request a number; it makes the abundance of signs accusatory, because the predicate attached to that abundance is people passing over them. The variant and sound rows make the abundance marker a recitational pressure point: hamza-heavy and contracted shapes shift between catch and flow while preserving the same counted referent.

topics.headline: abundance as rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are grammatically foregrounded and that their abundance itself becomes an indictment.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the quantifier the predication head with the passing clause as predicate, matching the CRITICAL rows about subject position and reproach.

topics.headline: variant sound pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the abundance marker is a recitational pressure point, while the variants do not change the counted referent.
topics.reason: The variant rows are useful as phonological apparatus, but the canonical local construction remains the same abundance quantifier.

words.gloss_range: specifier after the how-many quantifier with partitive/source shading toward the cosmic supply of signs

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite singular sign specified after the quantifier

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) prevents the quantifier from floating as vague abundance. It specifies the counted kind as a sign, while its partitive shade lets the signs feel drawn from a larger cosmic reservoir.

topics.headline: specifier with partitive shade
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices abundance becoming concrete: the many are specified as signs selected from a wider field.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the governed noun the specifying complement, and the CRITICAL rows coherently preserve both explanation and partitive/source pressure.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular sign or wonder, specified after the quantifier and tracked as one missed object through both later suffixes
words.root_gloss_range: sign, marker, wonder, and verse-like signal; disputed return/refuge derivation survives only as pressure toward recognition, not as the selected local sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: feminine singular suffix tracking the same sign through contact and aversion

words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَةٍ}} ({{tr:āyatin}}) makes abundance distributive: not a vague mass of signs, but one sign after another, each sufficient to confront the passer. The later suffixes keep that singular sign trackable through contact and aversion. Lexically, the word names a readable mark and wonder; the verse-sign range lets creation and recitation illuminate each other, while the disputed return/refuge derivation remains a pressure toward recognition rather than replacing the local sign sense. The surah has already used sign language for textual and narrative evidence (12:1, 12:7, 12:35), and this word expands that thread into the heavens-earth field. Wider sign-aversion echoes, including 15:81, 10:101, 10:92, 2:164, 3:190, and 45:3-4, show that present signs can still fail to benefit those who refuse them.

topics.headline: singular sign tracked through suffixes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah individualizes every sign instead of dissolving the failure into a general missed sign-field.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite singular after the specifier and is the antecedent of both later feminine singular suffixes, preserving the CRITICAL payoff about one-by-one encounter.

topics.headline: readable mark and wonder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the missed object as a readable wonder that should arrest and return attention, not as neutral scenery.
topics.reason: The local noun selects sign or wonder in the cosmic context; derivational dispute is preserved as recognition pressure without making return/refuge the local gloss.

topics.headline: cosmic and recited signs illuminate each other
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects cosmic signs with the surah's earlier textual and narrative signs, so creation is treated as readable evidence.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete surah-local and cross-Quran sign patterns; they frame the local cosmic sign without changing its grammar.

topics.headline: signs met by aversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this missed sign as part of recurring Quranic scenes where signs are present yet do not benefit those who refuse them.
topics.reason: The cited parallels include 15:81, 10:101, 10:92, 2:164, 3:190, and 45:3-4, and they add echo/provenance while leaving the local singular sign antecedent intact.

words.gloss_range: locative embedding that places signs and the human passing frame within the heavens-earth domain
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) embeds the signs inside the created order. The phrase can qualify the sign-field and frame the human motion at once, so the passing happens within the very environment already filled with evidence.

topics.headline: signs embedded in creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are not outside the world pointing in from elsewhere; they are embedded in the same space through which people move.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses the locative phrase, and the CRITICAL rows preserve both sign-location and scene-framing payoff.

words.gloss_range: definite plural elevated realm, the first half of the heavens-earth merism and a layered sign-bearing domain
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, sky, vault, and upper realm; local plural makes the elevated sign-field layered and familiar

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite grounded realm coordinated with the heavens

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) gives the sign-field an elevated, layered upper domain before the earth is added. As the first member of the familiar heavens-earth pair, it makes ignored evidence overhead, familiar, and already part of a canonical totality formula. The echo with Joseph's creator-invocation (12:101) turns confessed creation into evidence others overlook.

topics.headline: layered elevated sign-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the upper realm as layered with signs, not as a flat scenic sky.
topics.reason: The definite plural noun is governed by the locative and CRITICAL rows tie the local form to elevated, layered sign scope.

topics.headline: first half of cosmic totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah invokes the strongest high-low creation pair before naming human passing.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the heavens with earth under one preposition, and the CRITICAL rows preserve the totality formula.

topics.headline: creation confession becomes ignored evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this cosmic field with nearby and wider Quranic creation-language, especially Joseph's confession of the Creator (12:101).
topics.reason: The cited rows name 12:101, 11:123, 13:16, and other creation-pair settings as framing echoes without changing the local locative parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction completing the heavens-earth merism under one locative frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the small hinge that completes the cosmic pair. It does not start a separate scene; it binds the elevated realm and the grounded realm into one sign-location.

topics.headline: conjunction completes totality pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth is joined into the same sign-field rather than introduced as a new topic.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following noun coordinated with the heavens under the same locative phrase, matching the CRITICAL totality rows.

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth-domain, governed with the heavens as the grounded half of the sign-field
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, low or flat expanse; locally the underfoot domain where signs are traversed
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) lands the high-low merism in the ground beneath human movement. The canonical genitive keeps earth governed by the same locative frame as the heavens; variant case rows show how much that dependency matters. The word also makes the failure bodily concrete: signs are not only overhead but in the very domain people cross. Surah-local echoes move from earth as setting and power to earth as evidence, while 12:109 will contrast travel in the earth that looks with this passing that does not. The near-sound between this earth word and the closing aversion word pulls the ground-domain of signs toward the ayah's final sound of refusal.

topics.headline: grounded half of sign-field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are underfoot in the known earth-domain, not only distant in the heavens.
topics.reason: The standard form is genitive by coordination under the locative, and the CRITICAL rows preserve earth as a grounded sign-bearing expanse.

topics.headline: variant cases expose canonical dependency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the canonical case keeps earth inside the one locative merism, while variants only show alternative syntactic pressures.
topics.reason: Variant case evidence is useful as apparatus, but it does not replace the aligned canonical genitive dependency.

topics.headline: earth as evidence rather than mere setting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the earth of Yusuf's story and later travel commands to the earth now filled with signs people fail to read.
topics.reason: The rows cite surah-local and cross-surah earth/sign patterns, including 7:146, 12:21, 12:56, 12:101, and 12:109, as framing echoes.

topics.headline: near-sound binds ground and aversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the grounded sign-domain pulled toward the later aversion word by nearby sound and by the act of passing over earth.
topics.reason: The sound and underfoot rows add a local payoff: earth is both the sign-substrate and an audible neighbor of the closing aversion.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural intransitive passing with an over/upon prepositional complement, presenting repeated motion past signs without engagement
words.root_gloss_range: passing, traversing, going by, corridor-like passage; homophonous bitterness is only acoustic pressure, not the selected local sense
words.prose: {{ar:يَمُرُّونَ}} ({{tr:yamurrūna}}) turns the sign-field into motion: they keep passing over it. The imperfect and plural ending make this a repeated group behavior, while the prepositional complement gives contact without engagement. The root's passageway image makes signs into the route they use rather than the message they read; homophonous bitterness survives only as a sound-pressure on the act. Structurally, this verbal motion is immediately answered by a nominal aversion state, so proximity and refusal become simultaneous. Other motion scenes sharpen the selective-attention payoff: relief is followed by passing on in 10:12, transition does not necessarily become transformation in 7:189, and earth-passage can be morally charged in 17:4.

topics.headline: ongoing group transit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failure as repeated behavior by a group, not a single past incident.
topics.reason: The local verb is imperfect plural with an implicit 3mp subject, matching the CRITICAL aspect and subject-carriage claims.

topics.headline: motion over signs without grasping
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paradox: they are close enough to pass over the sign while still separated from it in attention.
topics.reason: The verb is intransitive with a prepositional complement, so the rows about traversal and over/away antithesis are locally licensed.

topics.headline: passage image with bitter sound-pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the passing as corridor-like movement that audibly flows past the sign, with bitterness only as resonance.
topics.reason: The selected local sense is passing/traversing; passage derivatives and sound rows are retained as image and cadence pressure, while bitterness is not made the lexical sense.

topics.headline: selective motion across evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this passing over signs with other Quranic scenes where motion or relief does not produce recognition.
topics.reason: The rows cite 10:12, 7:189, and 17:4 as contrastive motion settings; they frame the local verb without altering its grammar.

words.gloss_range: over/upon prepositional phrase with feminine singular suffix, making the sign a contacted surface of passage

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: away-from phrase using the same suffix with the opposite spatial vector

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهَا}} ({{tr:ʿalayhā}}) makes the sign the surface they pass over, and the suffix points back to the singular sign rather than to the heavens or earth as a whole. The same suffix will return in the away-from phrase, so one referent is heard under opposite relations: contact first, aversion next.

topics.headline: contact with the singular sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that each sign is directly traversed, not merely observed from a distance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition complement the passing verb and makes the suffix resume the singular sign.

topics.headline: sets up over-away reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears one sign carried through two opposed spatial relations, which turns the ayah's irony into grammar.
topics.reason: The later matching suffix and prepositional contrast are licensed by attachment evidence and are central in the CRITICAL rows.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial conjunction introducing a simultaneous nominal state clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the next clause into circumstance, not sequence. They pass while being averted; the particle makes the contradiction simultaneous rather than a later reaction.

topics.headline: simultaneous state pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that passing over signs and turning away from them occur at the same time.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following nominal clause as circumstantial, supporting the CRITICAL simultaneity payoff.

words.gloss_range: explicit third-person plural subject foregrounding the group as bearers of the aversion state
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) gives the group an explicit word in the state clause. The failure is not an impersonal drift of attention; the same people who pass are named as the bearers of aversion. The boundary also shifts from the messenger addressed in 12:104 to the collective they of this indictment, and the pronoun-state frame continues into 12:106.

topics.headline: explicit bearers of aversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that aversion is assigned to the people themselves, not left as a vague circumstance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the pronoun the subject of the nominal clause, and the CRITICAL rows preserve its agency and foregrounding payoff.

topics.headline: from messenger address to collective indictment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a discourse shift from the Prophet's non-demand in 12:104 to the people's ongoing aversion in 12:105 and 12:106.
topics.reason: The boundary rows give concrete adjacent references, and the local pronoun is the explicit marker of that shift.

words.gloss_range: away-from complement to the aversion participle with the same feminine singular sign suffix fronted before the predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: over/upon phrase with the same suffix

words.prose: {{ar:عَنْهَا}} ({{tr:ʿanhā}}) supplies the required away-from complement of aversion and repeats the same sign suffix used in the earlier over/upon phrase. Because it is fronted before the participle, the object of refusal is heard first: from that very sign, they are averted. The grammar therefore encodes the ayah's irony as opposed spatial vectors around one referent.

topics.headline: required object of aversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that aversion has a specified object and direction: away from the sign itself.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase the complement of the aversion predicate, matching the CRITICAL rows about governed separation.

topics.headline: same sign under reversed vector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same sign first as contacted, then as the object from which they turn away.
topics.reason: Both suffixes resume the same singular sign, and the fronted away-from phrase creates the locally licensed prepositional reversal.

topics.headline: reminder gives way to sign pronouns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the prior reminder into the sign-pronoun chain that shows what reminder is meant to restore to attention.
topics.reason: The boundary row is coherent with the local repeated sign suffix and the prior ayah's reminder frame.

words.gloss_range: active participle plural predicate naming a durable state of aversion from the sign at the ayah close
words.root_gloss_range: turning away, averting oneself, withdrawing, with breadth/display/exposure/interception branches supplying controlled crosswise image-pressure rather than replacing the Form IV aversion sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: ongoing plural passing over the sign
fronted away-from phrase specifying the sign as object of aversion

words.prose: {{ar:مُعْرِضُونَ}} ({{tr:muʿriḍūn}}) closes the ayah by turning the passing group into a class of averters. The active participle and nominal clause make aversion a durable state while they pass, not a later completed act. The root family gives the word bodily force: the selected Form IV sense is active turning away, while breadth, display, exposure, encounter, objection, and interception remain as contrast-pressure around the form that chooses sideways withdrawal. The final position makes that posture the verdict after abundance, cosmos, contact, and refusal have all been named. Echoes such as the command to turn away in 12:29, the sign-aversion formula in 15:81, aversion from reminder in 23:71, and the cosmic-creation setting in 46:3 all sharpen the close without replacing the local predicate. The rough onset and r-ḍ texture make the final word sound less smooth than {{ar:يَمُرُّونَ}} ({{tr:yamurrūna}}), while the participial state carries into the next ayah's further plural predicate (12:106).

topics.headline: durable aversion identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah classifies the group by a standing posture of aversion while they pass.
topics.reason: The word is an active participle predicate of the explicit pronoun in a circumstantial nominal clause, supporting state and identity rather than a punctual finite action.

topics.headline: Form IV turns display into withdrawal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels aversion as a bodily sideways turning from displayed signs, while local morphology keeps Form IV aversion as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root-family rows are valuable as image and contrast pressure, but the local surface is the Form IV participle of aversion, not Form V exposure or Form VIII objection.

topics.headline: active refusal rather than ignorance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failure as morally charged refusal while close to evidence, not mere absence of information.
topics.reason: The governed away-from complement and Form IV lexical evidence support active aversion or disregard rather than neutral ignorance.

topics.headline: closing verdict on motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah land on what they are while passing, making aversion the final verdict.
topics.reason: The closing nominal predicate follows the motion clause and shares cadence with the verb, preserving the CRITICAL action-state contrast.

topics.headline: aversion echoes across signs and reminder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this closing predicate to wider patterns of commanded turning away, sign-aversion, reminder-aversion, and cosmic-creation refusal.
topics.reason: The cited rows name concrete references including 12:29, 15:81, 23:71, and 46:3, which frame the local predicate without changing its parse.

topics.headline: sound and boundary carry the posture onward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the rough closing sound and sees the aversion posture carry from reminder into the next ayah's further predicate.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary rows add a local closing payoff and a concrete link into 12:106 without inventing a separate lexical sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sign, the heavens and earth, passing over them, and the concurrent state of turning away.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upper and lower bounds form an encompassing visible field. The subjects physically traverse its signs while the circumstantial clause makes side-turning concurrent with contact, so the failure is orientation during encounter rather than lack of evidence.

activation_trace.role: Visible signhood supplies the encountered object whose meaning remains unread.
What is above and overarching supplies the upper extent of the sign-field.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the field under ordinary human passage.
Going by and traversing makes contact with the sign-field continuous with ordinary movement.
Turning one's side supplies the bodily orientation that blocks uptake during contact.

changed_reading.before: People fail to notice scattered evidence around them.
changed_reading.after: People are already in contact with an all-encompassing sign-field, but enact non-recognition by maintaining a turned-away orientation while moving through it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sign-object and the form مُعْرِضُونَ share the activation range of ع ر ض.
baseline_models.mechanism: One branch exposes an object for inspection while another turns the subject's side away. Together they stage a reciprocal presentation: the world presents signs, and the observer counter-presents only a side.

activation_trace.role: A manifest mark supplies what is available to inspection.
Exposure to view supplies the world's presenting movement in the encounter.
Side-turning supplies the observer's answering movement away from what is presented.
Traversal makes this presentation and counter-presentation an encounter rather than two detached themes.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts visible signs with people who ignore them.
changed_reading.after: The verse dramatizes a failed exchange of orientations: signs face outward for inspection while passers answer by showing their side.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The abundance construction around آية and the temporal-repeat range of يمرون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Numerical abundance and recurrent encounters can produce familiarity without recognition. Aversion is therefore readable as habituated filtering, not only as a single explicit refusal.

activation_trace.role: The large-number force makes the sign noun participate in an abundance rather than an isolated-instance model.
Occurrence over time and repetition supplies repeated exposure to the abundant signs.
Turning away supplies the stable filter that can persist across repeated encounters.

changed_reading.before: Each ignored sign is an independent missed opportunity.
changed_reading.after: Countless repeated encounters may themselves harden into routine transit, so abundance does not guarantee attention and may expose a pattern of habituated refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: A scent is found before ordinary visual confirmation, is socially dismissed, and is followed by restored sight. This turns the focus signs from merely visual objects into multimodal traces whose recognition can be screened by prior judgment.

activation_trace.role: Manifest signhood anchors the scent sequence back to the focus category of a readable trace.
Side-turning supplies the focus response that social dismissal can perform before confirmation arrives.
Finding and hitting upon something supplies positive detection rather than vague atmosphere.
Odor and smelling supply a nonvisual carrier by which an absent source leaves a perceptible trace.
Recovered eyesight supplies the later visual confirmation that reorders the earlier scent encounter.

structural_cues: The 12:94 perception is rejected in 12:95 before the visual reversal in 12:96.
The sequence separates receiving a trace, socially classifying it, and later confirming it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: scent is found, the claim is dismissed, and sight returns. Reader: the scent is treated as an ayah-like trace and dismissal as a mechanism of i'rad. Alternative: this may be an exceptional recognition event rather than a general model of sign perception.

changed_reading.before: Passing over signs means failing to look at visible objects.
changed_reading.after: A passer may actually receive a sign through smell, memory, or another bodily channel yet turn from it by classifying the perception as error before it can reorganize sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier dream becomes legible as realized truth only from its eventual outcome. A sign can therefore be a trajectory whose sign-status emerges retrospectively, making passage through events part of interpretation rather than mere proximity to static objects.

activation_trace.role: Signhood anchors the later outcome as something that can disclose the meaning of an earlier event.
Passing and going onward supply the temporal carrier between initial appearance and eventual disclosure.
Return to an eventual issue supplies the retrospective operation that joins beginning to outcome.
The dream supplies an initially indirect form whose meaning is not exhausted by its first appearance.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the later realization that validates the trajectory.

structural_cues: 12:100 explicitly links a prior dream, its interpretation, and its becoming true.
The phrase marking what came before places a long interval inside the interpretive act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a prior dream is joined to its eventual truthful realization. Reader: that temporal arc is used to reinterpret passing over signs as passing through still-unfinished signs. Alternative: the retrospective mechanism may be specific to dream interpretation rather than the natural signs of 12:105.

changed_reading.before: Signs are complete objects already present for immediate inspection.
changed_reading.after: Some signs are extended sequences: one may pass through their early stages without recognition because their force appears only when the outcome folds back onto the beginning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus abundance is flanked by statements about the majority, while intense desire still fails to secure settled belief. The problem is thus a scaling failure: increasing signs or persuasive effort does not repair the orientation that filters them.

activation_trace.role: Large-number force supplies the abundance of signs whose evidential scale is being tested.
Repeated occurrence supplies cumulative exposure rather than a one-time missed datum.
Persistent side-turning supplies the bottleneck that more evidence does not automatically remove.
Numerical majority supplies the resistant population-scale counterpart to abundant signs.
Excessive desire supplies high persuasive effort that still does not force the response.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response that quantity and effort fail to manufacture.
A second majority expression after the focus confirms that the numerical frame is sustained across the passage.

structural_cues: Majority language in 12:103 and 12:106 brackets the abundance construction of 12:105.
The concessive clause in 12:103 blocks a simple more-effort-produces-more-belief model.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: abundant-sign, majority, intense-desire, and belief language cluster around the focus. Reader: their numerical symmetry diagnoses orientation as the conversion bottleneck. Alternative: the repeated quantity terms may be rhetorical emphasis without a shared scaling mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Many signs provide many independent chances to become convinced.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes why evidential accumulation can saturate without conversion: a stable mode of aversion can absorb both more signs and more persuasive effort.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah permits settled acknowledgment and association to coexist. This revises turning away from a simple synonym for total disbelief into selective orientation: a sign may be recognized while its claim is divided among partners.

activation_trace.role: Manifest signhood supplies what can be acknowledged without receiving an undivided response.
Side-turning supplies selective refusal within an otherwise partially receptive stance.
Assent that settles the heart supplies the real acknowledgment that can coexist with another orientation.
Participation and shared claim supply the mechanism by which response is distributed rather than absent.
Association with God specifies the divided allegiance that qualifies the neighboring belief.

structural_cues: 12:106 directly follows the focus and uses an exception construction that holds belief and association together.
Both ayat describe a concurrent state with وَهُمْ, first aversion and then association.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: belief and association are explicitly simultaneous in 12:106. Reader: that coexistence is carried backward to make i'rad in 12:105 selective or compartmentalized. Alternative: the two ayat may describe different populations, leaving i'rad as complete refusal.

changed_reading.before: Those who turn away have not recognized the signs at all.
changed_reading.after: Recognition can coexist with a sideways allocation of loyalty, so aversion may occur inside professed belief as refusal of a sign's exclusive claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mobile subject who passes over signs is followed by an event that can arrive, cover the subject, and escape fine awareness. The spatial relation reverses: what was treated as an exterior object of transit becomes an encompassing event.

activation_trace.role: Passing over supplies the initial geometry in which the human subject is mobile and the sign is traversed.
Turning away supplies the failed readiness that persists into the reversal.
General covering supplies the event that changes an exterior sign-field into an encompassing condition.
Sudden arrival supplies the temporal break that defeats routine passage.
Fine awareness supplies the perceptual capacity explicitly absent when the reversal arrives.

structural_cues: 12:107 repeats a وَهُمْ circumstantial ending but replaces active aversion with lack of awareness.
Its two arrival verbs move events toward the people immediately after 12:105 depicts people moving over signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: passers turn away, then an encompassing event or the Hour may arrive suddenly while they do not sense it. Reader: the sequence supplies a spatial reversal from traversing to being covered. Alternative: 12:107 may be only a consequence warning, not a transformed sign encounter.

changed_reading.before: Humans remain outside signs and choose whether to inspect them while passing.
changed_reading.after: Ignored signs may announce a reality that can invert the relation, making the former passer the enclosed object before fine awareness activates.

context_deltas.mechanism: Path, inward sight, and trace-following reorganize the focus locomotion. The decisive contrast is not movement versus stillness but bare transit versus movement governed by a route, discernment, and tracked succession.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary passing supplies motion without a stated destination or reading discipline.
Side-turning supplies the orientation that keeps motion from becoming guided attention.
An extended traversable path supplies direction and continuity to otherwise neutral movement.
Insight of the heart supplies the mode by which a path and its signs are knowingly read.
Following trace after trace supplies disciplined succession rather than accidental proximity.

structural_cues: 12:108 places calling on insight within explicit path language immediately after the focus.
The focus construction of passing upon signs is answered by the 12:108 construction of acting upon insight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: 12:108 joins path, insight, and following. Reader: these elements are treated as the positive locomotor alternative to passing while turned away. Alternative: the path may define the caller's mission without specifying how natural signs are read.

changed_reading.before: The problem is that travelers fail to stop and inspect signs.
changed_reading.after: Stopping is not the only remedy; movement itself can become responsive when it follows a coherent path on insight and tracks one indication into the next.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel in the earth is coupled to directed looking, outcomes, and reason. This operationalizes the focus: the earth is not merely scenery underfoot but an archive whose traces must be connected to consequences.

activation_trace.role: Passing supplies the under-specified movement that the later travel sequence makes purposeful.
The lower inhabited realm supplies the material field shared by ordinary passage and historical inspection.
Side-turning supplies the failed gaze that travel alone cannot cure.
Purposeful going through the land supplies the active counterpart to merely passing over.
Directing sight or insight supplies intentional inspection during travel.
The end and outcome supply the consequence layer that turns remains and events into signs.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the binding of observed trace to ethical consequence.

structural_cues: 12:109 repeats earth-language and explicitly sequences travel, looking, and asking about prior outcomes.
The closing question about reason prevents the gaze from ending at visual tourism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: travel in the earth is followed by directed looking at earlier outcomes and an appeal to reason. Reader: this later sequence unpacks what successful passing over earthly signs would require. Alternative: 12:109 may concern historical ruins only, leaving the cosmic scope of 12:105 broader.

changed_reading.before: Earthly signs are natural objects encountered along a route.
changed_reading.after: The land also stores historical causality; responsive passage means reading traces as outcomes and allowing that connection to restrain future conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: Trace-following in narrative and crossing from one case to another as admonition convert locomotion into interpretation. Mere passage fails when the observer crosses the sign spatially but does not let its meaning cross into an analogous present case.

activation_trace.role: The visible mark supplies the trace from which interpretation must begin.
Going from place to place supplies the physical crossing that can remain hermeneutically empty.
Turning away supplies the interruption that prevents observed form from becoming applied meaning.
Tracking an effect step by step supplies a disciplined way to follow signs through a sequence.
Movement from one side to another supplies the spatial image recast as transfer of meaning.
Taking one condition as admonition for another supplies the actual interpretive crossing.
Clarifying parts and meanings supplies the articulation needed before analogy can guide.
Gentle indication toward a way or truth supplies the directional result of successful crossing.

structural_cues: 12:111 sequences story, lesson, detailed articulation, and guidance.
Its lesson term follows a full narrative of movements, reversals, and outcomes, making transfer across cases structurally salient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: narrative trace-following, crossing, analogical admonition, detail, and guidance converge in 12:111. Reader: this convergence recasts the passing of 12:105 as a failed hermeneutic crossing. Alternative: the crossing image may belong only to the lexical history of lesson and need not activate the earlier motion verb.

changed_reading.before: People move across signs but fail to pause over them.
changed_reading.after: The deeper failure is crossing without transfer: bodies get to the other side, but the observed case never becomes an analogy that redirects the observer's own way.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س م و to و س م mapping rather than the ordinary sky branch. It remains anchored to the focus sky-word, sign noun, earth, and passage mechanism; downstream prose should label it an associative split-root activation, not a lexical replacement for السماوات.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sky-word's mapped marking branches joined to آية, earth, and passing.

activation_trace.role: Manifest signhood supplies the general category of a readable mark.
A visible identifying impression supplies the image of the sky as marked rather than merely elevated.
Reading condition from an outward trace supplies the interpretive act that ordinary passage lacks.
The fertile ground supplies a lower surface on which condition becomes materially visible.
Traversal supplies bodily movement across the marked surfaces without necessarily reading them.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth contain discrete signs.
changed_reading.after: Heavens and earth can be carried as continuously marked surfaces whose conditions are legible to a discerning observer, while passers move across the inscription without reading it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the indirect, two-faced speech branch is form-distant from مُعْرِضُونَ. It remains anchored to the same focus root and to the contrast between a visible sign and failed uptake; downstream prose should present it as a controlled root-association about latent meaning, not as the direct morphology of the participle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sign noun and the indirect-speech branch of the same root carried by مُعْرِضُونَ.

activation_trace.role: The outward mark supplies the perceptible face from which a further meaning may be inferred.
Indirect wording with outer and inner faces supplies a model in which signs disclose without exhausting their meaning on the surface.
Turning away supplies the refusal to move from the outward face toward the latent one.
Passing supplies contact with the outer face without interpretive penetration.

changed_reading.before: Signs are explicit evidence whose surface is already their full message.
changed_reading.after: Signs may work like allusive speech: their visible face points beyond itself, while aversion consists in allowing passage across the surface but refusing the inferential move inward.

strongest_changes: The 12:100 outcome structure turns static signs into trajectories that become legible retrospectively.
The 12:106 coexistence of belief and association makes aversion compatible with partial recognition and divided allegiance.
The 12:108-109 movement sequence distinguishes bare transit from path-governed insight and historical consequence-reading.
The 12:111 lesson structure turns physical passage into a test of whether meaning crosses from one case into another.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports simultaneous spatial, temporal, sensory, numerical, social, and hermeneutic readings. The most latent activations were scent as a previsual sign, reversal from traversing to being enveloped, and the split-root image of heavens and earth as marked surfaces.
remaining_uncertainties: The scent sequence may model sign perception generally or remain an exceptional recognition event.
The envelopment model may be a true spatial reversal or only an adjacent consequence warning.
The non-dominant marking activation is packet-resolved but remains associative rather than a replacement for the ordinary sky sense.
The crossing resonance in 12:111 is mechanistically coherent but may exceed an intended link to the passing verb.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Proximity to signs does not guarantee apprehension.** ء ي ي B003, س م و B004 (overhead sky), ء ر ض B001, م ر ر B001 (passing through), and ع ر ض B005 (turning one’s side away) create a spatial paradox. I infer that repeated passage can leave the sign merely adjacent when attention is laterally withdrawn. The ayah reads as failed activation despite abundant exposure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:109 corrected passive passing by commanding travel plus directed النظر at historical outcomes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Abundant visible signs defeated by directional attention.** `ء ي ي:B007` makes *ka-ayyin* an expression of multiplicity, `ء ي ي:B003` is a visible sign, `م ر ر:B001` is passing over or through, and `ع ر ض:B005` is turning one's side away and refusing attention. The ayah stacks many signs across heavens and earth, physical passage over them, and simultaneous aversion from them. The packet supplies proximity without uptake; I infer that the failure is not scarcity or distance but an orientation that converts encounter into non-observation. A sign therefore reads here as an offered relation requiring attention, not as self-enforcing proof.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:108 requires inner sight for the announced path, supplying the positive attentional discipline missing here: passing near signs must become evidentiary insight before proximity changes conduct.

يدخل فيه الوسم أو الوسمة اسم شجرة أو نبات ورقه خضاب، والعظلم الذي يختضب به.

branches.source_phrase_ar: مر الشيء يمر إذا مضى (maqayis)؛ المر المرور (ayn)؛ مر عليه وبه يمر مرا ومرورا ذهب واستمر مثله (sihah)؛ أمررت فلانا على الجسر إذا سلكت به عليه (tahdhib)؛ المرور المضي والاجتياز بالشيء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir eylemin tek bir gerçekleşmesini, birden çok gerçekleşmesini ve bunların zamanın bir parçası olarak sayılmasını açıkça bir araya getirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım tek kerelik birim ile tekrarlı kullanımı ayırır; bu kullanımlardan yalın bir hareket ya da geçiş anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir eylemin tek bir gerçekleşmesi ya da bu gerçekleşmenin zaman içinde sayılabilir bir birim oluşturmasıdır. Çoğul veya yinelemeli kullanım, eylemin birbiri ardınca birkaç kez gerçekleştiğini bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir eylemin tek gerçekleşmesi, zamanın sayılabilir bir parçası olarak ele alınır.
Aynı eylemin iki ya da daha çok kez gerçekleşmesi tekrarlı biçimlerle sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tek gerçekleşme ile zamanın bir parçasını aynı sayılabilir olay biriminde buluşturur ve çoğul biçimlerin eylemin tekrarını anlattığını belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir eylemin tek seferini ve aynı eylemin birden çok kez yinelenmesini kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Tek gerçekleşme, sayılabilir zaman parçası ve tekrar bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir eylemin yalnızca tek bir gerçekleşmesinin sayıldığı cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemin tek ve sayılabilir gerçekleşme olması özelliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aynı eylemin zaman içinde birden çok kez yinelendiği cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir eylemin birden çok gerçekleşmeyle yinelenmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ilk ya da tek gerçekleşmeyi de bağımsız bir zaman birimi olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geri gelen bir kereliği ve bir şeyi yeniden yapma eylemini özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir eylemin gerçekleşmesini sayılabilir bir kerelik olarak ifade edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta bir kez olma kendi başına yeterlidir ve tekrar zorunlu değildir; komşuda geri dönüş ve yeniden yapma bileşeni belirgindir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal her tür eylemin tek veya tekrarlı gerçekleşmesini sayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle bir inişin tek gerçekleşmesine ve kimi kullanımda hastalık nöbetine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir olayın tek defalık gerçekleşmesini zaman içinde sayılan birim yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu belirli bir olay türünden türemiş dar bir kerelik anlam taşır; odak dal olay türü bakımından genel ve tekrar bakımından geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal zamanı bir eylemin kaç kez gerçekleştiğine göre birimlere ayırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal olay sayısından bağımsız olarak vakit, süre ve dönem bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gerçekleşmeleri zaman içinde konumlandıran veya ölçülebilir kılan ifadeler taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta temel ölçü olayın gerçekleşme sayısıdır; komşuda temel kavram olaydan bağımsız zaman aralığı veya dönemdir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; seçilenler kerelik, tekrar ve zaman parçası sınırlarını doğrudan aydınlatır, sayı adları ve savaş gibi dar senaryolar ayrıca yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مرة ومرتين ومرارا وذات المرار، أي وقوع الفعل في مرة أو مرات أو في جزء من الزمان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: لقيته مرة ومرتين عبارة عن زمان قد مر (maqayis)؛ المر المرة (ayn)؛ جئتك مرا أو مرين تريد مرة أو مرتين (jamhara)؛ يصنع ذلك الأمر ذات المرار (sihah)؛ يصنعه مرارا ويدعه مرارا (tahdhib)؛ مرة ومرتين وذلك لجزء من الزمان (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مر الشيء وأمر إذا صار مرا، والمرارة ضد الحلاوة، والطعام أو الماء أو الدواء أو النبات المر، وما نسب إلى المرارة في المطعوم.
يدخل فيه إطلاق المرارة على الشر والشدة والدواهي، مثل الأمرين والأمرين والأمران، وما يدل على مرارة الفقر أو الهرم أو الهم أو المرض.
يدخل فيه أمررت الحبل وإمراره، والمر والمرار والممر والمرير للحبل المفتول أو شديد الفتل، وقوى الحبل ومرره.
يدخل فيه ذو مرة بمعنى قوي صحيح، والمرة قوة البدن أو العقل، والمريرة بمعنى العزيمة أو عزة النفس، واستمرار المريرة واستحكام العزم أو الخصومة.
يدخل فيه المرة مزاجا من أمزجة الجسد أو داء، والمرارة التي تكون في الحيوان، والممرور الذي غلبت عليه المرة.
يدخل فيه الأمر بمعنى المصارين التي يجتمع فيها الفرث، وما ألحق به من كلام المصادر في المرى أو المريان إذا كان من مرارة الخصال لا من المرور.

root_profile.summary: Kök, geçip gitme ve olayın kereliğinden acı tada, ağır sıkıntıya, sıkı burulmuş ipe, beden ve irade gücüne, eski beden sıvısı anlayışına ve bağırsak adına uzanan sekiz ayrı dal taşır. Son dalda bağırsak adıyla iki acı huy ifadesi aynı iddiada birleştiği için yapısal ayrıştırma gerekir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العرض الذي يخالف الطول، والعريض، وجعل الشيء عريضا، والجانب أو الناحية من الشيء.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasının görmesine veya değerlendirmesine sunmayı; mal, asker ve kitap gibi belirli nesnelerle açıkça örnekler. Dalın kimliği kendiliğinden görünme değil, bir failin yönelttiği sunmadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, nesnenin birine, satışa veya incelemeye sunulduğu yapılara bağlıdır; yalın kök anlamı olarak genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka birinin görmesi, incelemesi, okuması veya değerlendirmesi için onun önüne getirmek ya da belirli bir amaca sunmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir fail, bir nesneyi muhatabın görmesi veya değerlendirmesi için ortaya koyar.
Malın satışa sunulması, askerin denetlenmesi ve kitabın okunup karşılaştırılması bu yapının özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, bir nesnenin bir muhataba veya belirli bir değerlendirme alanına bilinçli biçimde sunulmasıdır; satış, denetim ve okuma bunun özel bağlamlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin muhataba, satışa, denetime ya da okumaya çıkarıldığı yapıların tümünü kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Failin yönelttiği sunmayı ve değerlendirme amacını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyi birine göstermek veya değerlendirmesine bırakmak bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi muhataba yöneltme eylemini korur.
error_profile.adds: Türkçedeki sunmak fiilinin burada bulunmayan ikram ve bildirme anlamlarını da çağrıştırabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal satış, asker denetimi ve kitap incelemesi gibi yapılara bağlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle hayvanı satış veya sınama amacıyla yürütüp yeteneğini ortaya çıkarabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi başkasına göstermek ve değerlendirmeye açmak anlamında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın yapısı nesneyi muhataba veya incelemeye sunmaktır; komşu dalda hayvanın niteliğini hareket ettirerek ortaya çıkarma gibi daha özel bir sınama da vardır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sunma eyleminin fail ve amaç sınırını en iyi açıklayan yakın anlamlı komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عرض الشيء أو الأمر على غيره، وعرض المتاع للبيع، وعرض الكتاب أو القرآن، وعرض الجند، وإبراز جهنم أو غيرها حتى يرى.
branches.source_phrase_ar: عرض المتاع يعرضه عرضا (maqayis)؛ يعرض علينا المتاع عرضا للبيع والهبة (ayn)؛ عرضت عليه أمر كذا وعرضت له الشيء أظهرته له وأبرزته إليه (sihah)؛ عرضت المتاع وغيره على البيع وكذلك عرض الجند والكتاب (tahdhib)؛ عرضت الشيء على البيع وعلى فلان وعرضنا جهنم (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما بدا وظهر للإنسان، وما استقبل من بعيد، والسحاب العارض، والجراد الكثير الذي يملأ الأفق، والجبل أو الشيء البادي عرضه.
يدخل فيه اعترض الشيء إذا حال ومنع، وعرض العارض، والتعرض للناس، والاعتراض في الطريق أو الأمر، واستعراض الناس قتلا أو أخذا من أي وجه.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiden veya işten yüz çevirip uzaklaşmayı, yanını göstererek dönme imgesiyle açıkça destekler. Bu anlam görünme, sunma veya fiziksel en ölçüsü değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yüz çevirme anlamını verir; engelleme ya da gösterme yapıları eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye veya konuya yönelmeyi bırakıp ondan yüz çevirmek, ilgiyi kesmek ve yanını dönerek uzaklaşmaktır.

facets.statement: Kişi, birinden veya bir konudan yönelişini geri çekip yüz çevirir.
Bedensel olarak yanını gösterip dönme, ilgiyi kesmenin görünür gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, bir kişiden veya işten yüz çevirip ilgiyi kesmektir; yanını dönme bu kopuşun bedensel görünümünü açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiden veya konudan bedensel ya da tutumsal olarak uzaklaşmayı birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yönelişi geri çekme, yüz çevirme ve ilgiyi kesmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya konuyla ilgilenmeyi reddetme bağlamında doğal ve doğrudan karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel dönmeyi ve mecazi ilgisizleşmeyi birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birinden yüz çevirmek, onunla ilgiyi kesmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal öznenin kendisinin yüz çevirip ilgisini kesmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başkasını bir şeyden engelleyip uzaklaştıran ettirgen kullanımı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişi veya şeyden yönelişi kesip uzaklaşmayı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal öznenin kendi dönüşüne ve ilgisini çekmesine bağlıdır; komşu dal hem öznenin uzaklaşmasını hem de başka birini engelleyip uzaklaştırmasını içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; öznenin yüz çevirmesiyle başkasını uzaklaştırma arasındaki sınırı gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أعرض عن فلان أو عن الأمر أو بوجهه، والصد عنه، والتولي مبديا الجانب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أعرضت عن فلان وأعرضت عن هذا الأمر وأعرض بوجهه (maqayis)؛ الإعراض عن الشيء الصد عنه (sihah)؛ أعرض عني فمعناه ولى مبديا عرضه (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عارضه في السير، وعارضه بمثل صنيعه، والمعارضة في الكتاب أو الكلام، والمبادلة بالمتاع أو الدابة، والمباراة.

branches.branch_image_ar: العرض الطارئ الذي يعرض ثم يزول
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العارض من الحمى أو السقم، وأحداث الدهر، والمرض والموت ونحوهما، وسهم عرض، والحب أو الرأي الذي يقع بغتة، والعرض الكلامي لما لا ثبات له.

branches.branch_image_ar: العرض متاع وبدل وحظ من الدنيا
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عرض الدنيا، والمتاع غير النقد، والعروض، وما يعطى بدلا عن حق، وما يعرض من المال أو العطاء.

branches.branch_image_ar: عرض الإنسان حماه وبدنه وظاهر وجهه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عرض الإنسان بمعنى حسبه أو نفسه أو بدنه أو ريحه، ونقاء العرض، وعارضا الوجه، والعوارض من الأسنان أو الخدود.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi açık söylemenin karşıtı olan, görünür sözün altında başka bir anlam taşıyan dolaylı anlatımı açıkça tanımlar. Evlilik niyetini üstü kapalı bildirme ve harfleri açık yazmama bunun bağlama bağlı örnekleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dolaylı anlatım çekirdeğini verir; belirli söz ve yazı örnekleri tüm dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi açıkça söylemek yerine, sözün görünür anlamı altında anlaşılabilecek başka bir yön bırakarak dolaylı biçimde anlatmadır.

facets.statement: Konuşan kişi niyetini doğrudan söylemez, sözün başka bir yönünden anlaşılmasına bırakır.
Sözün görünür ve örtük iki anlam taşıması dolaylı anlatımın belirgin yapısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, açık bildirim yerine görünür sözün altında ikinci bir anlam veya niyet bırakmaktır; farklı söz ve yazı bağlamları bu dolaylılığı örnekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Niyetin doğrudan söylenmeyip sözün görünür anlamı altından sezdirildiği kullanımları kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Dolaylılığı, görünür anlamı ve örtük ikinci yönü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir niyetin açıkça değil sezdirilerek anlatıldığı gündelik bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Açık söylememe ve dolaylı biçimde sezdirme işlevini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sözün görünür biçiminden genel anlamına, niyetine veya işaretine yönelmeyi daha geniş kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da sözün yüzeyinin ötesindeki anlam veya konuşma niyetine yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda konuşan kişi doğrudan söylemek yerine bilinçli bir örtük yön bırakır; komşu dalda yüzeyden anlama geçiş daha genel olup çift anlamlı söz şart değildir.

branches.branch_image_ar: معاريض الكلام وجه غير مصرح به
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التعريض خلاف التصريح، والمعاريض والتورية، والكلام الذي له ظاهر وباطن أو وجهان، والتعريض في خطبة النساء، وتعريض الكاتب إذا لم يبين.
branches.source_phrase_ar: معاريض الكلام يخرج في معرض غير لفظه الظاهر (maqayis)؛ التعريض خلاف التصريح والمعاريض في الكلام (sihah)؛ التعريض ما كان خلاف التصريح والمعاريض من الكلام (tahdhib)؛ التعريض كلام له وجهان من صدق وكذب أو ظاهر وباطن (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جعل الشيء عرضة أي منصوبا أو معرضا، وعرضة للأيمان أو للشر أو للناس، والقوة على الشيء كناقة عرضة للسفر.
يدخل فيه عرض الفرس في عدوه، واعتراض الفرس أو البعير إذا لم يستقم، والناقة العرضية أو العروض الصعبة، والتعرض في الجبل يمينا وشمالا.

branches.branch_image_ar: الشيء الموضوع عرضا أو المعترض عرضيا
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه وضع العود على الإناء عرضا، وعوارض السقف أو المحمل، وعارضة الباب، والمعراض السهم الذي يمضي عرضا أو لا ريش له.

branches.branch_image_ar: عروض ونواح وأسماء فنية أو موضعية
